versions.changelog:
AgentOctopus 1.3.0 — introduces skill evolution management

- Adds the AI-powered skill evolution feature: monitor usage signals, auto-propose changes, and maintain full rollback history.
- New command: octopus evolve for tracking status, reviewing, and rolling back skill changes.
- Skill evolution is opt-in and managed via config.
- SKILL.md updated with documentation for evolution lifecycle, commands, and workflows.
Add npm install -g agentoctopus instruction to quick start
Initial release: teach OpenClaw agents how to use the AgentOctopus skill router CLI
Added taskType=agent-collab for dimension-based rating, removed flat rating/invocations, added Rating & Feedback docs with sync commands
